newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistani rupee falls in kerb, seen lower.
newsitem.headline: Pakistani rupee falls in kerb, seen lower.

text.p: The Pakistani rupee fell 0.10 to 40.95 to the dollar in the kerb market on Wednesday as demand for the dollar rose abruptly after three bomb blasts in Karachi that killed a man and wounded three others, dealers said.
They said the rupee was likely to open lower on Thursday on higher demand for the dollar before Friday's weekend.

The State (central) Bank of Pakistan rate, last changed on September 10, was 36.9700/37.1549 rupees to the dollar. The premium on foreign exchange bearer certificates closed at 10.50 percent from the opening at 10.00 percent.
